values.en: Let $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{2}$ be open in the Euclidean topology and let $X\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{3}$ be smooth on $\Omega$ ($X\in C^{\infty}(\Omega)$; only the restriction $X|_{\Omega}$ is used). For $(u,v)\in\Omega$ the **partial derivatives** are $X_{u}(u,v)=\frac{\partial X}{\partial u}(u,v)=\left.\frac{d}{dt}X(t,v)\right|_{t=u}$ and, symmetrically, $X_{v}(u,v)=\left.\frac{d}{dt}X(u,t)\right|_{t=v}$. Because $\Omega$ is open and $(u,v)\in\Omega$, the coordinate line $t\mapsto(t,v)$ stays in $\Omega$ for $t$ near $u$, so the one-variable derivative is taken inside the domain; since $X$ is defined on all of $\mathbb{R}^{2}$, the expressions $X(t,v)$ and $X(u,t)$ are defined for every $t$. In the surface theory below, regularity means precisely that $X_{u}$ and $X_{v}$ are linearly independent at every point of $\Omega$.
values.zh-CN: 设 $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{2}$ 在欧氏拓扑下开，$X\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{3}$ 在 $\Omega$ 上光滑（$X\in C^{\infty}(\Omega)$；只使用限制 $X|_{\Omega}$）。对 $(u,v)\in\Omega$，**偏导数**为 $X_{u}(u,v)=\frac{\partial X}{\partial u}(u,v)=\left.\frac{d}{dt}X(t,v)\right|_{t=u}$，对称地 $X_{v}(u,v)=\left.\frac{d}{dt}X(u,t)\right|_{t=v}$。由于 $\Omega$ 开且 $(u,v)\in\Omega$，坐标直线 $t\mapsto(t,v)$ 在 $u$ 附近仍落在 $\Omega$ 内，故一元导数在定义域内取；又因 $X$ 定义在整个 $\mathbb{R}^{2}$ 上，$X(t,v)$ 与 $X(u,t)$ 对每个 $t$ 都有定义。在下文的曲面理论中，正则性正是指 $X_{u}$ 与 $X_{v}$ 在 $\Omega$ 的每一点线性无关。

values.en: Partial Derivative of a Parametrized Surface
